skills.title: Why Our Bodies Need Food
skills.description: Food gives you energy and helps your teeth, skin, bones, muscles, and brain grow strong. Pick the reasons why we need food.

skills.title: Staying Safe: Phones and Helpers
skills.description: Know your phone number, when and how to call 9-1-1, and which trusted adults can help you. Learn safe pickup routines too.

skills.title: Body Parts and Correct Names
skills.description: Match the right names to parts of the body, using respectful, body-positive words.

skills.title: The Five Senses
skills.description: Name our five senses and match each one to the body part that does the job. Find out what each sense tells our brain.

skills.title: Caring for Body and Mind
skills.description: Your mind is part of your health, just like your body. Pick things you can do to take care of both.

skills.title: Using Canada's Food Guide
skills.description: Canada's Food Guide shows foods that help us eat well. Sort foods and pick healthy choices for a plate.

skills.title: Hunger, Thirst, and Fullness
skills.description: Tell what your body feels when you are hungry, thirsty, or full. Pick what to do when you notice each one.

skills.title: Caring and Harmful Behaviours
skills.description: Sort kind, caring things from hurtful ones, like bullying or unsafe touching. Pick how they feel and what to do, including asking for consent.

skills.title: Being Safe at School
skills.description: Pick the safe things to do at school, like telling your teacher about allergies and playing in safe places. Choose safe ways to get to and from school.

skills.title: Germs and Clean Habits
skills.description: Put hand washing steps in order and pick ways to stop germs from spreading. Think about tissues, sleeve sneezes, brushing teeth, and not sharing hats.

skills.title: Spotting Dangers and Risks
skills.description: Find things that could hurt you at home, outside, near water, on the road, or online. Pick the safe choice.

skills.title: Habits That Harm or Help
skills.description: Sort habits like too much screen time, smoking, and vaping from healthier choices. Pick ways to help someone choose healthier habits.

skills.title: Thoughts, Feelings, and Actions
skills.description: What we think, feel, and do can change how our mind feels. Match thoughts and actions to good or poor mental health.
